subject: Mutual Action Plan: Brightline go-live runway and contingencies
content:
---Message 1 (oldest)---
From: Gina Park <gina@brightline.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff notes — need a clear MAP & target go-live

Jonas —

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. The execs asked us for a single, executable MAP that shows: milestones, who owns each action, target dates, and what falls back to a lower tier if we hit infra blockers.

Our preferred go-live window is the week of Nov 16 (internal blackout on Nov 9-12). Can you share an initial timeline and call out any dependencies on infra/network or SSO?

Also, do you have a short checklist for the CS handoff so our Ops team knows what to expect?

Appreciate it —
Gina Park
Program Manager, Brightline
G: 415-555-0199

---Message 2---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Gina Park <gina@brightline.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Kickoff notes — initial MAP draft + checklist

Gina — thanks, good context. Attaching a working MAP (brightline_map_draft_v2.xlsx) and our onboarding checklist. Highlights below:

- Proposed target go-live: 2026-11-18 (can shift +/- 1 week depending on infra certs)
- Key milestones:
  • SSO & SCIM validation (owner: Brightline IT) — due 2026-10-22
  • Network & egress rule verification (owner: Brightline Ops / REDWOOD NETWORKS) — due 2026-10-26
  • Sandbox load test (owner: Redwood SE / Priyom) — window 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-03
  • Data retention & audit log review (owner: Neha, Redwood Security) — due 2026-11-05
  • Cutover rehearsal & smoke test (owner: Marissa / CS) — 2026-11-12
  • Production cutover (owner: Brightline + Redwood) — 2026-11-18

- Contingency/fallbacks: if Network certification is delayed >3 business days we will:
  1) Run a restricted-capacity cutover (reduced QPS) with a single-region routing policy;
  2) Delay full ramp to the following week and run an extended smoke window.

Attachments: brightline_map_draft_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_onboarding-checklist.docx (document).

Requesting: Brightline to confirm blackout dates, SSO owner contact, and a point-of-contact for on-call during the cutover.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: 415-555-0123

---Message 3 (internal coordination)---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 15:35:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Kickoff notes — initial MAP draft + checklist

Thanks for the draft, Jonas. A few internal notes before we finalize:

- Neha: please confirm required log retention SLA and whether Brightline needs any custom retention policy in the MAP.
- Priyom: can you schedule the sandbox load test windows and confirm resource mapping (GPU capacity) — we should reserve the slot by Oct 20.
- I'll own the rehearsal plan and runbooks for cutover, and will draft a JIRA board for tasks (link to come).

Also want to flag an integration risk: Brightline indicated they use a third-party token proxy for requests. If that proxy adds latency >120ms per request we'll need to tweak autoscaling thresholds during ramp. Priyom / SRE should confirm.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---Message 4 (external approval + small edits)---
From: Gina Park <gina@brightline.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: ops@brightline.com, security@brightline.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Kickoff notes — initial MAP draft + checklist

Jonas / Marissa —

This is helpful, thank you. Confirming blackout window Nov 9-12. SSO owner is Samir Patel (samir.patel@brightline.com). Ops POC is ops@brightline.com and they will handle network certs; I copied them.

We have one small change: move the cutover rehearsal to 2026-11-13 (Mon) instead of 11-12 to avoid a company offsite. Otherwise the dates look good.

I'll upload a signed SOW to you by end of day — will that be DocuSign?

Best,
Gina

---Message 5 (final confirmation and links)---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Gina Park <gina@brightline.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Kickoff notes — initial MAP draft + checklist

Gina — great, thanks for the quick clarifications. I updated the MAP:

- Cutover rehearsal moved to 2026-11-13 per your note.
- Added SSO owner (Samir) in the contact column and Ops POC.
- Called out the third-party token proxy latency as an integration risk and added an action for Priyom to validate.

Next steps:
1) Brightline: sign SOW via DocuSign and share the signed copy (we'll link into the HubSpot deal).
2) Brightline Ops: confirm network egress rule checklist by 2026-10-20 (attachment: network_requirements.pdf).
3) Redwood (Priyom): schedule sandbox load test by 2026-10-20 and confirm capacity.
4) Redwood (Neha): confirm audit log retention fit by 2026-10-22.
5) Redwood (Marissa): publish cutover runbook and JIRA board by 2026-10-25.

I placed the updated MAP in the shared drive (link below) and added the three attachments to this thread. Once we have signed SOW we can lock dates and move to weekly cadence.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BrightlineMAPv2
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567
DocuSign (expected): https://www.docusign.net/brightline/sow/ABC123

Attachments referenced: brightline_map_draft_v2.xlsx, network_requirements.pdf, redwood_onboarding-checklist.docx

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the run.
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Phone: 415-555-0123

----End of thread----
